summary: Loxley police booked a 20-year-old man on a second-degree domestic violence charge early Friday, the jail roster shows. Ten new bookings had posted for Nov. 27–28 when the roster was read Saturday morning, plus 10 immigration detainers; no new federal, state or district attorney releases over the holiday.

entries.title: Domestic violence arrest, Loxley: Christian Daniel Fischer
body: Loxley police arrested Christian Daniel Fischer, 20, at 4:09 a.m. Friday, Nov. 27, according to the jail roster. No police statement or news report was found.
He was booked on a second-degree domestic violence charge, an assault-level charge involving a family or household member. He was in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 27–28: Immanuel Taylor, Roberto Lavell Howard, Robert Allen Starcher and others
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Immanuel Taylor, 25, at 12:53 a.m. Friday, Nov. 27, on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol. Bay Minette police arrested Roberto Lavell Howard, 40, at 4:53 p.m. Friday on a fugitive-from-justice charge, which is used to hold someone wanted in another state, and Mark Quincy Williams, 44, at 5:10 p.m. on five failure-to-appear/comply/pay warrants, one of them a traffic case. Robertsdale police arrested Robert Allen Starcher, 43, at 9 p.m. Friday on a felony failure-to-appear warrant.

Deputies also arrested Jonathan Wesley Jones, 41, on a public intoxication charge and Veronica Regina Brown, 42, on an alias writ for driving while suspended; the roster shows both released. On Saturday, Nov. 28, deputies arrested William Douglas Covan, 39, at 8:30 a.m. on a probation revocation. Vance Thomas Turner, 35, was booked Nov. 28 with no arresting agency or charge listed on the roster. All information is from the jail roster.

entries.title: Drug trafficking arrest: Jonathan Gordon Burton
body: Jonathan Gordon Burton, 49, was booked into the county jail with an arrest time of 3:40 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 26, under the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office, according to the jail roster. Fairhope police's own arrest log lists an arrest of a man of the same name at 7:31 a.m. that day at Greeno Road and Fairhope Avenue on a charge of unlawful possession of a controlled substance (THC edible). No police statement or news report was found.

On the roster he is booked on two counts of drug trafficking — possessing a controlled substance in an amount the law treats as trafficking — plus possession of dangerous drugs, illegal possession of prescription drugs and a first-offense drug paraphernalia charge. He was in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning.

entries.title: Burglary and theft arrest: William Lindsey Trosclair
body: William Lindsey Trosclair, 48, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 7:41 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 26, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.

He was booked on a burglary charge the roster describes as entering a non-residential building without force, two theft charges, second-degree criminal mischief — damaging property — and criminal tampering. He was in custody when the roster was read Saturday morning.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 26–27: John William Wayne, Robert Edward Steigerwald, Caitlin Dorothy Bell and others
body: State troopers arrested John William Wayne, 74, at 12:33 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 26 (Thanksgiving), on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol; the roster shows him released the same day. Sheriff's deputies arrested Robert Edward Steigerwald, 71, at 7:20 a.m. Thursday on a dangerous-drug possession charge; the roster now shows him released.

Deputies arrested Caitlin Dorothy Bell, 38, at 1:46 a.m. Friday, Nov. 27, on a harassment charge involving a family member. Deputies also booked Tony Lynn Rainbolt, 37, on a felony failure-to-appear warrant and Melissa Kaye Daniels-Hollingswort (as the roster prints the name), 48, on failure-to-appear and probation-revocation warrants, and Bay Minette police booked Steven Deandre Palmer, 28, on five failure-to-appear/comply/pay warrants. All information is from the jail roster.
